The final total line "Rechnungsbetrag EUR 23,74" corresponds to Zwischensumme 21,58 + MwSt 2,16 = 23,74 → select 23,74 as GrandTotal.Amount (the 23,03 appears to be after a possible skonto scenario).

- Net 21,58 + Vat 2,16 = 23,74 matches selected GrandTotal.Amount.
- Vat rate 10,00 % matches Vat.Amount relative to Net (21,58 * 0.10 = 2,158 → rounded/displayed 2,16).

4. No inference beyond visible values; when multiple possible totals existed, chose the final invoice total line supported by arithmetic.
